January, 2023

Author: Samit Gopal
Bench: Samit Gopal
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Court No. - 69
Case :- Application U/S 482 No. - 92 of 2023
Applicant :- Subodh Kumar Pandey

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Dharmendra Shukla,Subhash Chandra Maurya
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Samit Gopal,J.
List revised.
Heard Sri Subhash Chandra Maurya, learned counsel for the applicant, Sri S.B. Maurya, learned counsel for the State and perused the record.

The present application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed by the applicant Subodh Kumar Pandey, with the prayer to stay the proceedings of Case No. 122 of 2012, pending in the court of Civil Judge (Junior Division)/F.T.C. (CAW Kanpur Nagar) against the Case Crime No. 22 of 2008, under Sections 498A, 323, 506 I.P.C., Police Station Mahila Thana, District Kanpur Nagar, during pendency of this application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. and further be pleased to refer the matter before Mediation and Conciliation Centre for consideration of matrimonial settlement.
